stories.title: Create BEV C03 Thermal System Knowledge Assessment with Scenario-Based Diagnostics
stories.description: Create a comprehensive Knowledge Assessment document for BEV C03 (Thermal Management Systems) with scenario-based questions that require learners to diagnose and troubleshoot thermal cooling system failures, aligned with CoCU learning outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create KA.md file with minimum 8 scenario-based questions covering thermal system diagnostics, with each scenario including system state, symptoms, and required diagnosis
Include answer scheme with marking rubric (1-4 points per question) based on CoCU assessment criteria
Ensure 30% of questions test theoretical knowledge and 70% test practical diagnostic scenarios

stories.title: [Integration Test] Enhance BEV C01 KP technical depth — HV safety procedures and PPE specifications
stories.description: Write integration tests for the feature implemented in US-001. Story description: Review and enhance BEV C01 KP-01~03 Information Sheets for technical accuracy. Verify HV safety content matches OSHA 1994, EQA 1974, and manufacturer standards. Ensure PPE specifications (Class 0, CAT-III) are correctly detailed with proper Malaysian regulatory references.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests exist covering the core behaviour of US-001
Tests cover the happy path and at least one error/edge case
Tests run without requiring external services or manual setup
technicalNotes: Run: uv run pytest tests/ -k us_001 -v
